row.proto: void Gdb_HashMap_Insert(GdbDatabase *db, uint64_t key, uint8_t tag, char *text)
row.notes: Inserts or updates one record in db->map (robin_hood insert_move inlined). Callers: only Gdb_Load_GameDatabase's two record loops, plus the core's gamedb.cpp edits. Probes as Gdb_Lookup_Key; a new key takes a slot (count++, value 0), then the tag switch (jump table 0x145bee930, tags 0..0x12) parses text into the existing record or allocates one from g_Gdb_RecordAllocator vt+0x18; returns the record. Growth (increase_size) before placing a new key: mask 0 -> 8 buckets; count >= max_num_elements_allowed, or an info overflow with info_inc < 3 -> Gdb_HashMap_Rehash at site_Gdb_InsertGrowCall (2*(mask+1), or the same size with mult += 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec54 when count*2 < max); otherwise info_inc halves in place (try_increase_info, no rehash). 256 failed growth rounds -> overflow fatal 0x1445a66b0. Growth after records exist frees them all (Gdb_HashMap_Rehash), so an insert of a new key at count = max_num_elements_allowed (838,860 for 2^20 slots) leaves dangling records and the next reader crashes. Corrects the exe-agent note that the map grows safely | exe-agent label gdb_insert; ne_hash_map.h assert path B26 crash: ne_hash_map grows dynamically (lf 0.80, rehash FUN_1445a66c0), so DB record count cannot overflow the global game value DB table -> DB-too-big ruled out m1-verify: parses a typed text value (switch on type), inserts/updates it in the per-DB map; growth at load factor 0.8; failure path hits an int3 stub name kept because native/src/core/assets/gamedb.cpp and dbread.cpp bind it by this name (real role per m1-verify: set value from text)

verify.notes: V1346 Agree on role, callers (only 0x1445a0c3b and 0x1445a0e17; no absolute refs) and growth: count +0xd0 vs max +0xe0 (0x1445a13e3/0x1445a13ea); mask 0 -> inline 8 buckets (mask 7, max 6, block 0xf6, 0x1445a1450); info_inc >= 3 and count < calcMax -> halve info_inc, shift+1 (0x1445a151b, no rehash); else count*2 >= calcMax -> Rehash(2*(mask+1)) via 0x1445a1318, otherwise mult += 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec54 and Rehash(mask+1) via jmp 0x1445a1588; 256 rounds -> 0x1445a2078; new key count+1 at 0x1445a18f5. Disagree on the proto's return: the epilogue (0x1445a2058 mov [r14],rdi .. ret 0x1445a2077) stores the record into the slot and does not set rax (one path leaves eax=ebp at 0x1445a2050; Ghidra shows returns of 0, 0xe and 0x146cc42e0). Both callers and core gamedb.cpp/dbread.cpp ignore it, so the proto should be void; nothing the sizing hook needs depends on it
